From: Liam O'Connor <liam@umbratek.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Optimize toolkit pricing and technical fit

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited by the latency improvements you showed. We're evaluating Redwood's Optimize toolkit to reduce inference spend for our customer-facing chat product and have two quick asks before we present internally to procurement: 

1) High-level pricing for a 3-month pilot (expected ~15M tokens/month) including any pilot credits you can offer.
2) A summary of technical recommendations you would make for batching, KV caching, and quantization for a workload that averages 512 tokens per request with p99 latency target of 350ms.

Also curious whether any upfront commitment or a small reserved pool is required to get the quantization advisory and batching/ops handoff. Procurement wants a clear path to a discount if the pilot shows the expected 30–40% unit-cost reduction.

Can you send a short commercial/technical proposal by end of week? If useful we can schedule 30 minutes with our infra lead.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
VP Product, Umbratek
liam@umbratek.com

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@umbratek.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit pricing and technical fit

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and for the time last week. Putting a short proposal below; attaching a one-page pilot SOW and an example schedule. Happy to jump on a call to walk through details.

Commercial summary (pilot):
- Pilot length: 3 months (start = production validation, up to 15M tokens/mo expected).
- Pilot credits: 20% usage credit applied to billed tokens for pilot period (applies to hosted Redwoods models or recommended open model variants).
- Optional reserved burst pool: 2x baseline concurrent capacity for a month at a discounted hourly rate (recommended for ramp).
- Post-pilot: if you commit to a 6–12 month reserved band we can convert 30% of unused pilot credits into committed discount credit (structure in SOW).

Technical recommendations (initial):
- Batching: start with continuous batching with target batch window 25–40ms and max batch size 128 for your 512-token median request; we typically see best TCO/latency tradeoff in that region for transformer-based 7–13B variants.
- KV caching: prefix caching for repetitive prompts (we recommend enabling LRU TTL of 15 minutes for session reuse) and a small warmed cache for top 10 intents. Expect ~25–35% token savings where reuse is high.
- Quantization: recommend mixed-precision 8-bit (Q4) for the main traffic path to preserve quality; run a subset (5–10%) of requests through FP16 to monitor drift. For latency-sensitive paths we can provide a 4-bit quantization experiment but only after a quality eval.

Deliverables included in pilot: 1-page SOW, weekly ops checkpoints, quantization advisory report (end of pilot), 2 knowledge-transfer sessions with your infra team.

Next steps: I can send a formal offer and DocuSign if this shape looks good. I'll loop in Connor (ops) and Priya (commercial) for pricing detail.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Attachment: Umbratek_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf stub)
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: UM-2027-019 — pilot offer / pricing runbook

Connor/Priya (and Karthik for technical signoff) — quick internal note to align before I send the formal counter to Umbratek. Liam's ask is exactly the pilot shape we want to use as a playbook, but procurement will press on credits -> committed conversion. Proposed commercial structure:

- Pilot credits: 20% of estimated pilot spend (applies across tokens/embeddings used for the pilot) — gives them a 3-month runway.
- Conversion incentive: if they sign a 9-month reserved tier within 30 days of pilot close, convert 30% of pilot credits into committed discount (applied pro rata across months).
- SLA add-on: offer 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated routes (extra fee) — Liam may ask later.

Technical guardrails and ops asks for Karthik/Connor: 
- Quantization: propose two-step advisory — (A) immediate deployable Q4 mixed-precision config with rollout on 10% of traffic; (B) controlled 4-bit experiment gated by eval thresholds (we require quality delta < 1.5% measured by their prompt set).
- Batching config: set batch window 30ms, max batch 128; enable adaptive batch expansion if p95 latency < 200ms for a sustained period.
- KV caching: enable prefix caching; provide a small warm-up script for their test set; add metrics to monitor cache hit ratio target >= 20% by week 4.

I recommend we price pilot at list less 10% plus the 20% pilot credit — this simplifies the math for procurement while protecting our margin. Priya, can you draft a one-page commercial term that matches this and include the DocuSign link? Connor/Karthik, please flag any technical showstoppers.

Evelyn

Subject: Redwood pilot offer & technical handoff (UM-2027-019)

Hi Liam — following up with a formal offer and next steps. Summary below and attached are the SOW and a proposed schedule. Please review; if everything looks good I'll send the DocuSign and we can start onboarding next week.

Offer summary (pilot):
- Duration: 3 months; expected avg 15M tokens/month.
- Price: list rates for selected open-models (see SOW) with 10% introductory discount + 20% pilot credit applied to billed tokens in pilot period.
- Conversion incentive: sign 9-month reserved band within 30 days after pilot close -> convert 30% of unused pilot credits into committed discount credits.
- Optional SLA add-on and burst capacity available (priced separately).

Technical summary (what we'll deliver):
- Initial batching config: 30ms window; max batch size 128; monitoring dashboard and an ops playbook.
- KV caching: prefix caching enabled; we will run a 2-week warm-up to seed hot prefixes; target cache hit ratio >= 20% by wk4.
- Quantization advisory: Q4 mixed precision rollout on 10% of traffic during pilot; run a controlled 4-bit experiment if quality thresholds are met. We'll deliver a short advisory report at pilot close with performance/quality results and recommended commit bands.

Attachments: Umbratek_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Optimize_Toolkit_Schedule.xlsx
Related link: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/UM-2027-019

If this structure works, we'll send the DocuSign (link included) and schedule the onboarding call for next Wednesday. Thanks — happy to hop on a call to walk through any element.

Best regards,
